title: Quickly Fermented Algerian Pork Shoulder Steaks Tagine
description: A tender and flavorful weeknight dish featuring fermented pork shoulder steaks in an authentic Algerian tagine.

ingredients.name: Fermentation spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together fermentation spice blend, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder steaks, making sure to coat them evenly.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the pork shoulder steaks to a large bowl or container with a lid.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent and the garlic is fragrant.
Add the cooked onion mixture to the bowl with the pork shoulder steaks.
Mix in 1/4 cup of water and cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the pork to ferment.
Transfer the fermented pork shoulder steaks to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the pork is cooked through and tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
